text:
Product Overview
PM3019FSNR V2 has 16*10/100Mbps adaptive RJ45 ports, 1*1000Mbps    Combo port and 1* 1000Mbps RJ45 port, and each RJ45 port supports MDI/MDIX auto-flip and wire-speed forwarding. Among them, ports 1-16 have PoE power supply function ports 9 -16 support remote transmission, support IEEE802.3af/at standard, the maximum power of the port can be up to 30W, and can be used as Power over Ethernet devices, which can automatically detect and identify the powered devices that comply with the standard, and supply power to them through the network cable. This product is simple and convenient to use, no need to configure, can meet the Enterprise, Community, Hotel, Office Network and Park Network Networking and access requirements.
Product Features
Supports 802.3af/at standard;
Single PoE port output power up to 30W;
Automatic detection PD equipment;
9-16 port 100Mbps data transmission and PoE power supply distance up to 300M (typical value), 10Mbps data transmission and PoE power supply distance up to 800M (used with remote equipment);
Supports one-click PD-ALIVE, VLAN, CCTV, and SCP modes.
Support IEEE802.3x full duplex flow control and Backpressure half duplex flow control;
Support 8K MAC address, automatic learning and automatic update;
Panel indicator to monitor working status and help fault analysis;
Product Specifications
Hardware Specifications
Model	PM3019FSNR-260 V2
Interface	16*10M/100Mbps RJ45 Ports / 1*1000Mbps Combo Port / 1*10M/100M/1000Mbps Uplink Port
Standard	IEEE802.3,IEEE802.3i,IEEE802.3u,IEEE802.3z,IEEE802.3ab,IEEE802.3x,IEEE802.3af, IEEE802.3at
Network media	10BASE-T: UTP category 3,4,5 cable(≤100m) / 100BASE-TX: UTP category 5, 5e cable(≤100m) / 1000BASE-X: UTP category 5e, 6 cable(≤100m) / 1000BASE-X: MMF, SMF
Indicator	PWR(Green), LNK/ACT(Green), PoE(Orange),PoE Max(Green)
MAC Address Table	8K, Auto-learning, Auto-update
Jumbo frame	9216Byte
Packet buffer	4Mbit
Transfer Mode	Store-and-forward
Packet Forward Speed	5.36Mpps
Switching Capacity	7.2Gbps
Remote port	Port 9~16
PoE Port	Port1~16
PoE Power on RJ45	1/2(+),3/6(-) 4/5(+),7/8(-)
PoE Power Output	30W (Max)
PoE Power Budget	250W
Power supply	260W
Input Power Supply	AC:100-240V,50/60Hz,5A Max
Dimensions(L*W*H)	280*180*44mm
Operating Temperature	0°C ~ 40°C
Storage Temperature	-40°C ~ 70°C
Operating Humidity	10% ~ 90% non-condensing
Storage Humidity	5% ~ 90% non-condensing
Surge Protection	Differential mode ±2KV,Common mode ±4KV
Electrostatic standard	Contact ±6KV, Air ±8KV
MTBF	>50000 hours
Ordering Information
Model	PM3019FSNR V2
Product Information	16FE+1GE +1G Combo long-range PoE Switch
